_about: 1-Pentanol (1) + 1-Propanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1-pentanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 1-pentanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: E. Lladosa, J. B. Monton, M. C. Burguet, R. Munoz, Vapor liquid equilibria in the ternary system dipropyl ether + 1-propanol + 1-pentanol and the binary systems dipropyl ether + 1-pentanol, 1-propanol + 1-pentanol at 101.3 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 247 (2006) 175-181
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 12, 13. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0072. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.75 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
